# K.R. Mangalam University

> K.R. Mangalam University (KRMU) is a private, multidisciplinary university on Sohna Road, Gurugram, Haryana, India. It was established in 2013 under the Haryana Private Universities Act, 2006, and is NAAC 'A' accredited. KRMU has 13 schools offering undergraduate, postgraduate, doctoral and diploma programmes in engineering, management, law, pharmacy and allied health, physiotherapy, liberal arts, architecture and design, basic sciences, media, hotel management, education and agriculture.

Key facts:

- Address: Sohna Road, Gurugram, Haryana 122103, India
- General helpline: 011-48884888, 8800697010 to 8800697015, 8192888444
- Admissions portal: https://admissions.krmangalam.edu.in/
- Entrance exam: KREE (K.R. Mangalam University Entrance Examination)
- Admission steps: apply online, pay the application fee, take KREE, attend a faculty-led interview, receive the offer letter, enrol

## Schools

- [School of Engineering & Technology](https://www.krmangalam.edu.in/school-of-engineering-and-technology): B.Tech., BCA, B.Sc., MCA and Ph.D. programmes in CSE, AI & ML, data science, cyber security and more
- [School of Management & Commerce](https://www.krmangalam.edu.in/school-of-management-and-commerce): BBA, B.Com., MBA and Ph.D. programmes
- [School of Legal Studies](https://www.krmangalam.edu.in/school-of-legal-studies): Integrated and three-year law degrees, LL.M. and Ph.D.
- [School of Medical & Allied Sciences](https://www.krmangalam.edu.in/school-of-medical-and-allied-sciences): Pharmacy and allied health programmes
- [School of Physiotherapy and Rehabilitation Sciences](https://www.krmangalam.edu.in/school-of-physiotherapy-and-rehabilitation-sciences): Bachelor of Physiotherapy
- [School of Liberal Arts](https://www.krmangalam.edu.in/school-of-liberal-arts): English, economics, psychology and political science
- [School of Architecture & Design](https://www.krmangalam.edu.in/school-of-architecture-design): Architecture, fine arts and design programmes
- [School of Basic & Applied Sciences](https://www.krmangalam.edu.in/school-of-basic-and-applied-sciences): Physics, chemistry, mathematics and forensic science
- [School of Emerging Media & Creator Economy](https://www.krmangalam.edu.in/school-of-emerging-media-and-creator-economy): Journalism and mass communication
- [School of Hotel Management & Catering Technology](https://www.krmangalam.edu.in/school-of-hotel-management-and-catering-technology): B.HMCT
- [School of Education](https://www.krmangalam.edu.in/school-of-education): B.Ed., B.El.Ed. and Ph.D.
- [School of Agricultural Sciences](https://www.krmangalam.edu.in/school-of-agricultural-sciences): B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture
- [Zenith School of AI](https://zenithschool.ai/): AI-focused school
